invocation.text:
Use orchestrate-feature for #1895. I give you explicit permission to approve as many review rounds as are reasonable for each ticket and merge the PRs yourself.

#1895 is a Task umbrella, not a Feature; its Description and Scope are the design of record. Its 11 children are compiles that produce no program, or a wrong one, with no diagnostic. #1617 is the one engine-divergence bug left from the two-engine sweep, retitled on 2026-10-15 to describe the program engine alone, with a failing test already in its body; the other eight were closed that day and are not to be reopened.

The children carry no blockers, so plan them in these units:
- One writer for the four no-program compiles, which share the compile pipeline and the umbrella's new harness assertion that a compile yielding no program carries at least one Error diagnostic: #457, #1325, #1502 and #1641.
- #1103, #1299, #1617 and #1645 are independent wrong-lowering fixes. Several are likely to touch SparkdownCompiler.ts or the same lowerer, so before dispatching a second writer read the first writer's draft PR for the files it touches and hold any ticket likely to collide.
- #454, #887 and #316 come last. #316 holds three pre-existing defects; its writer may split it into three tickets under this umbrella if the fixes share no cause.

A second coordinator is running #1893 on this machine at the same time, so init with --concurrency 3. Any new ticket filed under the umbrella gets the "Compilation robustness" milestone.

authority.reviewRounds: the coordinator's checkpoint decision after round 3's verified fixes and after every later round's, published on the PR through review-checkpoint.mjs, with this invocation as the authority for an extension within ten rounds or an acceptance of verified final corrections
authority.merge: the coordinator merges this Feature's PRs that pass integration.mjs's merge gate, with an expected-head merge call and never a bypass of branch protection
authority.diskRecovery: the guarded clean-worktrees classifier's merged-and-removable entries only, each recorded here

concurrency.basis: invocation override (default would be 3: the smaller of 3 (reviewer slots) and 7 by memory at 4 GB per writer; each plan also admits only as many writers as free disk allows at 6 GB per writer)
